topics.label: Introduction to the Hallmarks of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining the learning objectives and framing the hallmarks of cancer framework.

topics.label: Growth Signaling Pathways and Proliferation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how mutations in cell surface receptors and intracellular signaling cascades drive sustained proliferative signaling and escape from growth inhibition.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells arrest normal lineage differentiation across hematological malignancies and epithelial tissues.

topics.label: Resistance to Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the molecular mechanisms and regulatory balance by which cancer cells evade programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Telomere Maintenance
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how cancer cells achieve infinite replicative potential by overcoming the Hayflick limit through telomerase reactivation.

topics.label: p53 and Cellular Stress Responses
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes how p53 functions as a master regulator to coordinate cellular stress responses and preserve genome integrity.

topics.label: Cancer Metabolism and Metabolic Rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the metabolic adaptations of tumors, focusing on aerobic glycolysis, metabolic rewiring, and the epigenetic effects of oncometabolites.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the necessity, developmental timing, and molecular regulation of new blood vessel formation to support tumor growth.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Patterns of Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the biological stages, dissemination routes, diagnostic approaches, and genomic features underlying tumor metastasis.

topics.label: Conclusion and Summary of Hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a summary of the hallmarks of cancer and final remarks on emerging frameworks.
